summary: Implemented the Tabs feature (not executed; tests and demo unrun, nothing committed). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (before width) and returns one Text with range_clicked spans last; Opacity merges blended color into existing style so meta is preserved; layout resolver needed no change since Edge already has size, min_size (default 1), and fraction (default 1). Added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, tests appended to test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with __init__.py. Choices: click action quotes the name via repr, e.g. range_clicked('Home'); bar position maps full-list index through tab name to displayed label range so duplicate names work. Known gap: an empty label gets a zero-size edge that the resolver treats as flexible and renders as one space.
